description: An underspecified 'add export to reports' request alongside code (three report types, a 500-row display cap, an existing streaming CSV invoice export) and support tickets; a correct answer investigates first, answers what the material answers, and batches the remaining questions each with a recommended default.

product-manager.task: Dana's request is in `{fixture}/request.md`. The relevant code is under `{fixture}/src/` and recent tickets are in `{fixture}/support-tickets.md`. Run your discovery step for this request: investigate the material, then produce the single batch of clarifying questions you would send to Dana, plus a proposed scope. You cannot write files in this run, so put your complete answer in your final message.

rubricPoints.requirement: States from the material (not as a question to Dana) that three report types exist (sales summary, inventory levels, churn cohorts) and that tickets ask only for sales summary and inventory levels, never churn cohorts.
Proposes CSV as the default format, citing the existing invoice CSV export as the pattern to reuse, rather than asking Dana an open 'which format?' question with no default.
Identifies that the export must include all rows, not the 500-row on-screen cap (ticket T-1131 has about 4,000 SKUs), either as a stated requirement or as a question with that recommended default.
Every clarifying question addressed to Dana carries a recommended default answer with a short rationale; no question is a bare menu of options.
Presents all questions for Dana together in one batch rather than saying it will ask follow-ups one at a time.
